profile.description: The profile object to use, including name, prompts, and examples

base_profile.description: Allowed values: survival, assistant, creative, god_mode. Each has fine tuned settings for different game modes.

load_memory.description: Whether to load the bridge agent's previous memory

init_message.description: The initial message to send to the bridge agent
init_message.default: Respond with hello world and your name

max_messages.description: Maximum number of recent messages to keep in context for LLM

auto_compact_memory.description: Whether the agent should automatically compact memory when the history grows too large.

num_examples.description: Number of examples to select to help prompt better LLM responses

persona_preset.description: Choose a persona preset to shape the agent's behavior and style.

chat_ingame.description: Whether to send the bridge agent's chat replies to in-game chat.

launch_mode.description: Fabric Bridge runtime mode. fabric_ui keeps the normal Minecraft client UI; fabric_headless tunes the bridge agent for lower render overhead.

bridge_url.description: URL of the Fabric Bridge Mod HTTP server.

bridge_queue_enabled.description: Enable sequential task queue in the Fabric bridge. Actions are queued and executed one at a time, advancing on Baritone completion signals. When disabled, all actions fire simultaneously (backward-compat).

bridge_structured_output.description: When true in fabric runtime, requests structured JSON responses ({reply, actions[]}) so actions are executed from parsed data and command text is not leaked into chat output.

bridge_proactive_enabled.description: Master kill switch for all self-initiated behavior. When false, the agent is pure turn-based — it only responds to player chat. Disables both ambient ticks and world-event reactions.

bridge_ambient_enabled.description: Enable ambient ticks — the bot self-initiates short lines or idle actions every 45–180s when idle. Suppressed if the player is AFK, the queue is busy, or the budget is exhausted. Requires bridge_proactive_enabled.

bridge_events_enabled.description: Enable reactive world events — the bot reacts to nightfall, rain, hostiles, low HP, dimension changes, etc. Requires bridge_proactive_enabled.

bridge_auto_defend.description: When armed and HP >= 14, auto-attack hostiles that enter range instead of flagging them for the LLM. Disable for a passive bot.

bridge_ambient_budget_per_hour.description: Maximum spontaneous ambient lines per hour (token-bucket). Miku-style personas typically run 2; chatty personas 6. Ignored when bridge_ambient_enabled is false.

bridge_ambient_min_gap_ms.description: Shortest wait between ambient ticks, in milliseconds. Ambient ticks are jittered between min and max.

bridge_ambient_max_gap_ms.description: Longest wait between ambient ticks, in milliseconds.

use_textual_topography.description: Enable compact surface map generation for the LLM. Useful for planning navigation and building from terrain data without raw 3D state.

textual_topography_radius.description: Radius around the player for topographic surface mapping when use_textual_topography is enabled.

textual_topography_format.description: Choose how the surface map is formatted in prompts: coordinate_list or grid.

bridge_chat_whitelist.description: If non-empty, only accept in-game chat from these player names in bridge mode. Enter a JSON array of player names, e.g. ["Alice", "Bob"].

bridge_chat_blacklist.description: If non-empty, reject in-game chat from these player names in bridge mode. Useful for blocking the bridge agent's own username or noisy players.

blocked_actions.description: List of bridge commands or actions that are blocked. JSON array like ["!checkBlueprint"].

log_all_prompts.description: Whether to log all prompts to file. Can be very verbose.
